correctness.rationale: Exact F11 field normalization and gradient enumerate all 133 primal points, 90 smooth rational contacts and 72 tangent-line coefficients. No dual line lies wholly in the Gauss set (max 11 of 12). Published p=11 blocking-set classification and triangle characterization prove all size-18 covers must come from the 4 square/nonsquare patterns on a noncollinear vertex triple. The independently executed standard-library verifier checks all C(72,3)=59640 triples, 55129 noncollinear triples, all 4 patterns, yielding exactly six distinct candidate sets; it checks the full primal 133-point coverage multiplicities 90,15,25,3 and the free S3 orbit. This is a proof by exhaustive finite enumeration after a published mathematical classification, not a sample or unproved universal extrapolation.

value.rationale: The natural first admissible prime-field example of the Asgarli–Ghioca tangent-filling construction already had a sharp optimal-cover certificate. Classifying all such certificates is an intrinsically motivated rigidity question about its rational Gauss-image incidence configuration. The exact count six, a unique free coordinate-symmetry orbit, and the complete selection criterion resolve the previously explicitly unclassified natural finite object, rather than recomputing the old minimum size. This meaningful complete classification is restricted to F11 and requires no speculative downstream theorem.
